# Wizard Web

> Custom websites for small businesses, built fast and hosted free. Costa Rica and
> North America. Web craft that looks like magic to the people who receive it and like
> disciplined engineering to the people who build it.

Wizard Web builds custom websites for small and local businesses. Not templates: each
site is built for the business it belongs to, with a focus on search visibility, AI
visibility, and page speed.

## What we offer
- A custom website, live within 24 hours of the brief, from $500 USD. Domain
  registration included if the client does not have one.
- Free basic hosting, permanently.
- A growth service at $50/month: search optimisation plus two to three published
  articles a week.
- A full AI kit from $1,000: the website plus a chatbot, voice agent, AI receptionist,
  and WhatsApp integration.

## How we work
- Every site is checked on desktop and mobile before a client sees it.
- Real photographs, never AI-generated imagery on a real business.
- Every claim on a client's site is verifiable or it does not ship.

## Where we work
Costa Rica, in Spanish and English. Canada and the United States, in English.
